answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks through orbital time-of-flight attestation. Nodes register by timestamping radio pulses during a satellite's voyage overhead using a spiral antenna coupled to an oscillator the size of a pearl. An attacker incurs the verifiable hardware expense of maintaining geographically dispersed receiver nodes per identity. However, ionospheric turbulence distorts signal transit times, triggering false rejections of honest agents.
